question.text: When assessing a client's risk profile, the PM should:

answer.text: Assess both willingness and ability/risk tolerance through the risk questionnaire and align recommendations with the assessed risk profile
Force the client into higher-risk strategies

explanation.text: The Logic: Risk profiling assesses both willingness and ability (risk tolerance) using a risk questionnaire so that recommended portfolios are aligned with the client's assessed risk profile. The Trap: The PM should not force a client into a higher-risk strategy than the assessed profile permits, even when ability is high. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers workbook, p.17, p.149, p.164-165.
